_about: Your scanner settings. Every screener uses the 'standard' filters plus its own. Percent values are percents (10 = 10%).

standard._low52: TradingView wording 'Low 52W below Price by 30% or more' = the 52-week low is at most 70% of the price

lists._setups_higher_high_low: off (your choice, Oct 25) · strict = the last two swing highs and lows are rising · structure = stays on until price breaks the last higher low
lists._no_chase_1y_pct: off (your choice, Oct 25); a number (e.g. 300) skips stocks up that much in 12 months

msf._about: MSF settings that differ from v29.2 (empty = v29.2 as written)
